{{Top|leg}}
'''HighGround RockyPlain TwentyKilometer Left''' was a section of the surface of [[Nickel One]]; located twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] down the left side of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces launched their initial attack on the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] from this location, following the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. Hoping to sabotage the exhaust ports that dispersed excess heat from the asteroid's main fusion plant that were located here, the desired effect would cause the plant to explode.<ref name="LOTF">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
